item.title: Fact Finding Mission to Emirates and Qatar
item.description: As part of AGYA projects, I have been on a Fact Finding Mission (FFM) to a couple of universities in Emirates and Qatar. I had the pleasure to meet Dr. Henda Mahmoudi from ICBA, Dr. Nisreen Alwan from Abu Dhabi University, and Dr. Mohammed Yaqoubi from MBZUAI in Emirates and Dr. Sami Zaqout, Dr. Susu Zughaier and the dean of the Medical Faculty, Prof. Marwan Abu-Hijleh, at Qatar University in Qatar.

item.title: Organzie the Summer School on Affordbale AI (SAAI -- سعي)
item.description:
We have just wrapped up an amazing week at the Summer School on Affordbale AI (SAAI – سعي).

As the curtains close on an unforgettable week in Bonn, we reflect on the enriching experiences shared at the AGYA Summer School on Affordable AI. We were thrilled to host 60 guests, including 35 students from nations across the globe; 🇲🇷 Mauritania, 🇲🇦 Morocco, 🇹🇳 Tunisia, 🇩🇿 Algeria, 🇱🇾 Libya, 🇪🇬 Egypt, 🇵🇸 Palestine, 🇱🇧 Lebanon, 🇯🇴 Jordan, 🇸🇾 Syria, 🇮🇶 Iraq, 🇴🇲 Oman, 🇶🇦 Qatar, 🇰🇼 Kuwait, 🇸🇦Saudi, 🇦🇪 UAE, 🇾🇪 Yemen, 🇰🇲 Comoros, 🇩🇪 Germany, 🇷🇺 Russia, 🇮🇹 Italy, 🇺🇦 Ukraine, 🇫🇷 France, and 🇨🇴 Colombia alongside 15 faculty and AGYA members, and 6 dedicated tutors.

🚀 Our diverse participants engaged deeply with innovative AI concepts, learning from esteemed speakers, lecturers, and each other. The collaborative environment fostered not only education but also meaningful connections across cultural lines.

🌐 Social events at iconic locations like the Cologne Cathedral, Drachenburg Castle, and the Haus der Geschichte Museum provided fantastic backdrops for our participants to unwind and network, enhancing their cultural and academic experience.

Thanks to everyone who made this event a huge success—your enthusiasm and insights have truly shaped this summer school into a beacon of learning and international cooperation.

Special Thanks to the Arab-German Young Academy of Sciences and Humanities (AGYA) for the financial support. I would like to thank The University of Bonn, Universitätsklinikum Bonn, Helmholtz AI for the host and financial support as well.

item.title: Attending the general assembly of the Arab German Young Academy
item.description: I had the pleasure to meet such brilliant scientists from all over the Arab world and Germany in the general assembly of the Arab-German Young Academy of Sciences and Humanities in Berlin!

item.title: Research Visit at the University of Sharjah, UAE
item.description: I have just completed the research visit at the University of Sharjah, NYU Abu Dhabi, and other esteemed universities. This initiative aims to strengthen connections and foster collaboration between German and Emirati academic institutes in the field of health and medical sciences. I will soon return to the Emirates to organize a one-day workshop on AI and healthcare at a prestigious academic institute. Stay tuned for more details!

item.title: Participate at the AGYA Winter School on Quantum Materials
item.description: It was a pleasure participating at the AGYA Winter School on ‘Quantum Materials for Energy and Environmental Technologies’ at Sharjah, UAE. The school seamlessly integrates networking opportunities for both Arab and German students, alongside expert presentations focusing on new materials for sustainable energy technologies.

item.title: Fact Finding Mission to the United Arab Emirates
item.description:
Just wrapped up an incredible 72-hour agya fact-finding mission with the brilliant Vice-Presidents and Provosts of top universities in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, UAE. The main goal of our fact-finding mission is to promote the call for membership of the Arab-German Young Academy of Sciences and Humanities (AGYA)!

Dr. Nada El Darra and I had the pleasure to meet Vice-President Sultan Al Haji, the Acting Provost Prof. Tim Baldwin at MBZUAI (Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence), and the Acting Provost and Chief Academic Officer Prof. Michael Allen at Zayed University besides our brilliant colleagues Dr. Rania Dghaim, Dr. Fatme Al Anouti, and Dr. Omar Alfandi.

Thanks to our alumna, Dr. Henda Mahmoudi, and her colleagues Nour El Jundi and Evans Kioko, we very much enjoyed the wonderful field trip at International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) where we discussed potential interdisciplinary research collaboration on AI and Food Safety!

item.title: Fact Finding Mission to Amman, Jordan
item.description: Just arrived from Amman, Jordan! It was just an amazing trip to Amman where I met our clinical partner King Hussein Cancer Foundation and Center for one of our projects supported by the Arab-German Young Academy of Sciences and Humanities (AGYA)! I was also happy to accept the invitation of my former PhD student, Tariq Bdair, and the head of his department, Dr. Serin Atiani, to deliver a talk at Princess Sumaya University for Technology! I was impressed by the level of their students, indeed! I would like also to thank Dr. Omar Al-Kadi from The University of Jordan for the invited talk and the great hospitality!

item.title: Co-Organizer of the Introduction of Bioinformatics to Arab Education System
item.description: I had the pleasure last week of co-organizing a workshop on Bioinformatics in Tunisia. The workshop was part of the working group activities supported by the Arab-German Young Academy of Sciences and Humanities! We had a great lineup of speakers from Germany/Switzerland and Arab countries! I had the pleasure to know a couple of Arab scholars from Egypt, Lebanon, Algeria, Tunisia, and Sudan.
